definition: tier: TFT Academy's editorial label (S, A, B, C), an opinion, not a statistic; no games or placements. Owner (2026-10-21): the tier mixes power with how hard the comp is to reach and is not a head-to-head ranking; e.g. Draven Ezreal 9 is A because finishing it (2-star 5-costs at level 9) is hard, but a finished board beats the S comps.
